localContext: Toledo combines two refineries on the Maumee's east side, Jeep and powertrain plants, glass and thin-film solar manufacturers, a Great Lakes port and Davis-Besse nuclear station on Lake Erie. Work runs to API codes for refinery pressure equipment, ASME and AWS for fabrication, and customer quality manuals in automotive supply. Technicians usually start with visual and surface methods and add UT, so self-paced theory plus an employer-site practical suits shift workers and plants.
certPathwayNote: Most Toledo employers certify technicians under their own ASNT SNT-TC-1A written practice: the employer certifies, a course does not. Refinery, automotive and nuclear sites may add owner or customer requirements, which the employer's Level III reconciles. ASNT central certification is the alternative route, and Atlantis prepares candidates for it.
